name: Dorm Days
source:
Finally, you are a college student now! And you know you're gonna meet a lot of guys here! They say college life is full of surprises and possibilities. You never know what will happen next. So just enjoy your days in the dorm with the guys!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076510/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
最后，你现在是一名大学生了！你知道你会在这里遇到很多人！他们说大学生活充满惊喜和可能性。你永远不知道接下来会发生什么。所以就和大家一起享受在宿舍的日子吧！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076510/]Steam[/url]]
